functions.name: public.sgp_cargar_paquete_semanal
locks: order by p.key_produccion for update of p loop

functions.name: public.sgp_mecanizado_reprogramar_orden
locks: select * into v_origen from public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion where id_programacion=p_id_programacion for update;

functions.name: public.sgp_admin_maestro_piezas_guardar
locks: select * into v_antes from public.sgp_maestro_piezas where codigo_sap=btrim(p_codigo_sap) for update;

functions.name: public.sgp_mecanizado_parte_mover
locks: select * into strict mp from public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion where id_programacion=p_id for update;

functions.name: public.sgp_export_aprobar
locks: FOR f IN SELECT * FROM sgp_export_revision.filas WHERE lote_id=p_lote_id AND estado='PENDIENTE' AND (cardinality(tipo_cambio)=0 OR id=ANY(coalesce(p_filas,ARRAY[]::uuid[]))) ORDER BY key_produccion FOR UPDATE LOOP
SELECT * INTO old FROM public.sgp_producciones WHERE key_produccion=f.key_produccion FOR UPDATE;

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER parcial_proteger_header BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_mecanizado_parcial.proteger()
CREATE TRIGGER sgp_mecanizado_validar_prioridad_nueva BEFORE INSERT ON public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_mecanizado_validar_prioridad_nueva()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_pdt_manual_programacion_origen BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_pdt_manual.proteger_programacion_origen()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_sgp_mecanizado_programada_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_mecanizado_programada_al_insertar()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_sgp_mecanizado_programada_update BEFORE UPDATE OF estado ON public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_mecanizado_programada_al_actualizar()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_sgp_pdt_programacion_origen BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_pdt_proteger_programacion_origen()
CREATE TRIGGER parcial_proteger_detalle BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion_detalle FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_mecanizado_parcial.proteger_detalle()
CREATE TRIGGER sgp_mecanizado_prevenir_detalle_duplicado BEFORE INSERT ON public.sgp_mecanizado_programacion_detalle FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_mecanizado_prevenir_detalle_duplicado()
CREATE TRIGGER lp_plan_catalogo AFTER UPDATE OF excluida_export, id_linea ON public.sgp_producciones FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_lp_operacion.plan_observar_catalogo()
CREATE TRIGGER parcial_proteger_total BEFORE UPDATE OF cantidad, produccion, id_linea, key_produccion ON public.sgp_producciones FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_mecanizado_parcial.proteger_total()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_pdt_anio_inmutable BEFORE UPDATE OF anio ON public.sgp_producciones FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_pdt_manual.proteger_anio_programacion()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER trg_pdt_manual_auditar_programacion AFTER UPDATE ON public.sgp_producciones DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sgp_pdt_manual.auditar_programacion()
